subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Default Heuristic
description: A quick, practical guide to The Default Heuristic.

hook.text: Austria has 99% organ donation. Germany has 12%. The only difference: Austria's form opts you in by default.

buildup.text: Johnson and Goldstein showed that default options dominate. Most people never switch from what's pre-selected.

discovery.text: The default heuristic: when we're unsure or busy, we accept whatever is pre-chosen. Defaults are powerful.

twist.text: This isn't laziness. People interpret defaults as recommendations. 'They must have set it this way for a reason.'

climax.text: Whoever designs the default designs the outcome. Most people will never change it.

punchline.text: The default usually wins. Choose it wisely.

quiz.question: Why do people tend to stick with defaults?
options: They always agree with the designer's choice
They view defaults as recommendations and switching takes effort
Defaults are always the best option
